UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Platoon Commander / Block Organizer posts on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 295 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Recruitment 2026 has started on 16 June 2026, and candidates can apply until 06 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Recruitment 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 June 2026
  • Last Date : 06 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 13 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
